children: Turkish consumer price inflation rose to 1.84% month-on-month in August, just below expectations, while the annual figure was 31.51%, data from the Turkish Statistical Institute showed on Thursday.

In a Reuters poll, the monthly inflation rate was forecast to be 1.93% as rising oil prices driven by tensions between Iran and the United States continue to pose an upward risk to inflation with the annual rate seen at 31.62%.
The data also showed the domestic producer index rose 2.57% month-on-month in August for an annual increase of 27.95%.
